page.overview:
Who is Maverick?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Maverick was individually carded as part of the Battle Force 2000 subset of G.I. Joe at the very end of 1987. In 1988 he was available carded in a special two-pack with Blocker and was discontinued the following year. ----

Appearance: brown hair; white shirt with silver armor vest (with olive green chest panel); blue gloves; white pants with silver belt, blue pockets, and olive green boots

Accessories: blue helmet with ribbed collar and open space for eyes; silver laser pistol with rounded energy chamber. ----
